build: Modwerk's linker: the vendored core-ar2 0.7 + this folder's Improved SMPL 0.6.0-experimental (with Ping Pong Loop folded in), materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version MS01

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: card images with generated samples (RAMP, 24,000 frames; RAMP and PIPO_SLOW, a 0.6 s slow sine; a 23,777-frame RAMP for the RATE and TUN screens), JIT on

conditions: LOOP and zero-snap screens: SETUP (cold boot on a card holding a generated 0.5 s rising ramp, RAMP.wav, added with dtcard): dtboot ms01.syx --card card.img --instr 14800M --every 99999M --press NO@2000M --press NO@2300M --press NO@2600M --press NO@2900M --press GLOBAL@3300M --press DOWN@5100M --press YES@5400M --press DOWN@5700M --press YES@6000M --press DOWN@6300M --press YES@6600M --press DOWN@6900M --press YES@7200M --press RIGHT@7500M --press DOWN@7800M --press DOWN@8100M --press YES@8400M --press YES@8700M --press NO@10100M --press NO@10300M --press NO@10500M --press NO@10700M --press SMPL@11000M --turn 3:6@11300Mx6/30M --press YES@11700M --turn 6:6@12500Mx6/30M --save setup.snap (BD: SMP 1, LOP ON, SAMPLE page). Each capture then resumes setup.snap. A turn of +8 raw counts is one detent; stock's encoder hysteresis drops the first detents after the setup's turns, so more turns are sent than values. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified. WAVE (for the zero-snap and label captures): the same setup on a card holding RAMP and PIPO_SLOW (28,800 frames, crossings every 2,880 frames), then dtboot ms01.syx --load setup.snap --instr 800M --every 99999M --turn 3:8@14900Mx3/80M --press YES@15200M --save a.snap; dtboot ms01.syx --load a.snap --instr 1000M --every 99999M --turn 3:-8@15700Mx4/80M --press YES@16100M --press SMPL@16400M --save wave.snap (BD: SMP PIPO_SLOW, LOP ON, SMPL WAVEFORM). The end frame is DTBOOT_END_PNG. RATE and TUN screens: SETUP: a card holding one generated 23,777-frame ramp from -26,000 to +26,000 (RAMP.wav, dtcard add), then dtboot ms01.syx --card card.img --instr 14800M --every 99999M --press NO@2000M --press NO@2300M --press NO@2600M --press NO@2900M --press GLOBAL@3300M --press DOWN@5100M --press YES@5400M --press DOWN@5700M --press YES@6000M --press DOWN@6300M --press YES@6600M --press DOWN@6900M --press YES@7200M --press RIGHT@7500M --press DOWN@7800M --press DOWN@8100M --press YES@8400M --press YES@8700M --press NO@10100M --press NO@10300M --press NO@10500M --press NO@10700M --press SMPL@11000M --turn 3:6@11300Mx6/30M --press YES@11700M --turn 6:6@12500Mx6/30M --save setup.snap (BD on the ramp, LOP ON, SAMPLE page; the kit's FIN, now RATE, is +0). R63: dtboot ms01.syx --load setup.snap --instr 1000M --every 99999M --midi bd197f@14900M --save r63.snap (CC 25 127 on the auto channel: RATE +63). Every report interval is 99999M: rytm-emu c5732f0 drops a panel event that falls on an --every boundary. Captured on MS01 (0.6.0) on 16 Nov 2026; every frame, intermediate turn frames included (126), is byte-identical to the same plans on MS00, the vendored core with Ping Pong Loop 0.1.2 and Improved SMPL 0.5.1 side by side.
